## **October 17, 2026 — Assignment Discussion and Formatting Project Plan**

**Activity and Purpose**

Update each group member on what I’ve understood about the assignment I’ve been tasked to summarize (project planning and task list) with the information shared in a Google Document as well as creating a template for the project plan to be submitted.

**My Contribution**

I presented significant requirements of the project plan to my teammates and gave insight on how we will format the planning document. Afterwards, I created the template of the full planning document, complete with all the requirements specified in the assignment on Lexue. 

**Outcome**

I finished the first version of the planning document, complete with sections for team member information, project scope and learning goals, details on deliverables and their format, a schedule and workflow plan, a master task list, and a log of AI usage within the assignment.

**Learning and Reflection**

Overall, this task taught me how to structure planning documents that are easily understandable for other people. One significant realization I had after finishing this task is that I haven’t been making plans that often. This is most likely the reason why I struggled on where to begin at first. However, this task proved to be an insightful exercise that I can use to plan better in the future.

## **October 20, 2026 — Update Teammates on the Project Plan Format and How to Fill it**

**Activity and Purpose**

Each member presents their assignment format and explains how the rest of the group members can fill it in, making sure everyone contributes to each of the assignments.

**My Contribution**

I presented my finished project plan and task list format to the rest of the team in our second meeting, giving instructions on how and what to fill in the document.

**Outcome**

My teammates gave feedback on several parts of the project plan, such as changing the schedule format to better represent tasks to do per week and removing redundant categories in the master task list and AI log. Other than a few minor changes, for the most part, everyone agreed on the overall structure of the planning document.

**Learning and Reflection**

Since I’m not used to planning on a scale as large as this project, I learned that effective planning is not only being able to structure a development of tasks and activities, but also filtering the most significant details for each milestone so that information is presented concisely. On a side note, I also get to experience how sharing ideas with other people lets me see flaws in my output and correct them accordingly.

## **October 22, 2026 — Intensive Project Plan Revision and Content Discussion**

**Activity and Purpose**

Making major changes to the project plan and task list to better fit the requirements stated in the assignment details. Hence, I will continue updating the document until a solid structure is created.
